notify.channelFailing.text: Deliveries through the {channel_type} channel {channel} are failing: {error}. Rowbird counts further failures on this alert and sends a message when the channel works again.
notify.channelFailing.title: Channel {channel} is failing
notify.channelRecovered.text: Deliveries through the {channel_type} channel {channel} work again.
notify.channelRecovered.title: Channel {channel} recovered
notify.passwordReset.text: Someone asked to reset the password of your Rowbird account. Open the link below within {minutes} minutes to choose a new one; it works once. If it was not you, ignore this email: your password stays the same.
notify.passwordReset.title: Reset your Rowbird password
notify.reportFailing.text: A run of {report} failed with {error_code}. Rowbird counts further failures on this alert and sends a message when the report succeeds again.
notify.reportFailing.title: Report {report} failed
notify.reportPaused.text: {report} failed {failures} times in a row, so it was paused. It will not run on its schedule until someone resumes it.
notify.reportPaused.title: Report {report} was paused
notify.reportRecovered.title: Report {report} recovered
